categories.main_business_segments: Leyard Optoelectronic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the LED display industry, focusing on intelligent LED display products, cultural tourism night tours, and AI & spatial computing. The intelligent display segment accounts for over 85% of revenue, including micro LED, small pitch LED, and large pitch LED products. The company also develops and sells LED cinema screens, smart LED integrated machines, and provides XR virtual shooting solutions. Additionally, it offers motion capture technology and immersive digital experiences in cultural tourism.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leads in Micro LED technology, pioneering mass production of micro LED displays with chip sizes below 50 microns using substrate-free micro LED and massive transfer technology. It employs multiple packaging technologies including MIP, COB, and SMD, with a focus on reducing pixel pitch to as low as 0.3mm. Leyard integrates quantum dot technology with Micro LED for enhanced display performance. It also develops proprietary AI platforms, motion capture systems (OptiTrack), and spatial computing technologies, leveraging AI and big data for intelligent display and immersive applications. Manufacturing includes automated, digitalized production lines and smart supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Leyard serves a broad range of customers including government agencies, commercial enterprises, entertainment venues, education institutions, transportation hubs, and cultural tourism sectors. Its products are used in command centers, retail, advertising, sports stadiums, cinemas, virtual production studios, and smart city projects. The company targets both B2B and B2G markets globally, with emerging focus on consumer markets through high-end home theaters and AR glasses. Key customers include large-scale projects in China and overseas, especially in North America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Latin America.
categories.geographic_coverage: Leyard operates globally with a strong presence in China, North America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Latin America. It has production bases in Beijing, Shenzhen, Changsha, Wuxi (China), Slovakia (Europe), and is constructing a new factory in Saudi Arabia to serve Middle East markets. The company maintains localized sales and service teams in the US (Planar brand), Hong Kong, and emerging markets in Asia, Africa, and Latin America. Its international marketing network covers over 160 countries and regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Leyard operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the LED display supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, system integration, and end-user solutions. It has vertically integrated capabilities in micro LED chip production, packaging, module assembly, and display system integration. The company collaborates closely with upstream chip and IC suppliers and invests in supply chain consolidation to enhance cost control and product quality. It also provides software, content, and operational services, moving towards an integrated ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in Micro LED technology, quantum dot displays, AI integration, and spatial computing. It invests heavily in R&D to reduce Micro LED costs, improve chip transfer efficiency, and develop new packaging methods. Leyard is expanding AI applications in intelligent display management, immersive cultural tourism, and robotics training. The strategic roadmap (2025-2027) emphasizes AI empowerment, deepening B2B market penetration, expanding consumer applications, and global market expansion. It also focuses on digital transformation, smart manufacturing, and ecosystem development.
categories.revenue_model: Leyard generates revenue primarily through the sale of LED display products, including intelligent displays, cinema LED screens, and integrated LED machines. It also earns income from system integration projects, cultural tourism services, and AI & spatial computing solutions. The company employs direct sales, channel distribution, leasing, and e-commerce models. Additionally, it receives government subsidies and investment income. Revenue recognition varies by product type, including point-in-time and over-time methods based on contract terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Leyard is a global leader in the LED display industry, recognized for pioneering Micro LED mass production and advanced display technologies. Major competitors include Shenzhen Unilumin Technology, Shenzhen Absen Optoelectronic, Daktronics (USA), Samsung Electronics, Hikvision, and Xiamen Qiangli Jucai. Leyard holds a strong market position in both domestic and international markets, with a diversified product portfolio and comprehensive global footprint. It competes on technology leadership, product quality, and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Leyard reported total revenue of approximately RMB 7.15 billion, with a 6.11% decline from the previous year, mainly due to industry competition and market demand fluctuations. Net profit was negative RMB 889 million, impacted by significant goodwill and intangible asset impairments totaling over RMB 730 million. The company’s operating cash flow remained positive at RMB 667 million. Micro LED revenue doubled in 2024, exceeding RMB 800 million, supported by expanded production capacity. Leyard maintains a large asset base of over RMB 13.7 billion and continues to invest in R&D and global expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Leyard emphasizes its global technology leadership in Micro LED and small pitch LED displays, offering superior image quality, high brightness, low power consumption, and long lifespan. Its proprietary substrate-free Micro LED technology and massive transfer process enable ultra-fine pixel pitches and cost-effective production. The company integrates AI and spatial computing to provide intelligent, customizable display solutions and immersive experiences. Leyard’s comprehensive product range, global manufacturing footprint, and end-to-end ecosystem services differentiate it as a one-stop provider for advanced visual display and interactive applications.
